name: Hita Onsen & Mikuma River

en.name: Hita Onsen & Mikuma River
en.description: A historic hot spring resort situated along the serene Mikuma River. Famous for its summer houseboats (yakatabune) where visitors can enjoy dinner on the water while watching traditional cormorant fishing (ukai).
highlights: Relax in soothing hot springs with river views
Experience traditional cormorant fishing from a houseboat (summer)
Enjoy scenic walks along the Mikuma River promenade
en.openingHours: Open 24 hours for riverside area; Onsen bath and ryokan hours vary.

ja.name: 日田温泉・三隈川
ja.description: 三隈川沿いに旅館が立ち並ぶ歴史ある温泉地。夏場の屋形船が名物で、水上での食事や伝統的な鵜飼い見学が楽しめます。
highlights: 三隈川を望む温泉でリラックス
屋形船からの鵜飼い見学（夏季）
三隈川沿いの遊歩道を散策
ja.openingHours: 川沿いは24時間開放。各旅館・立ち寄り湯の営業時間は異なります。
